# Backdrop

Backdrop is a component of `@kozmos-ds/react` whose docs do not describe it yet.

- **Import:** `import { Backdrop } from "@kozmos-ds/react";`
- **Group:** Feedback
- **Platforms:** React, SwiftUI and Compose; linked to its Figma component through Code Connect.
- **Storybook:** <https://vodoco.github.io/kozmos-design-system/storybook/?path=/docs/feedback-backdrop--docs>

## Example

From its `Default` story.

```tsx
import { Backdrop, ThemeProvider } from "@kozmos-ds/react";

export function BackdropExample() {
  return (
    <ThemeProvider defaultTheme="light">
      <div className="h-64 w-full relative border">
        <div className="absolute inset-0 flex items-center justify-center">
          Content behind backdrop
        </div>
        <Backdrop className="absolute" />
      </div>
    </ThemeProvider>
  );
}
```

## Backdrop

It forwards its ref to `HTMLDivElement`. Its props are `React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement> & { visible?: boolean }`.

- `visible`: `boolean`, optional, default `true`.
- `children`: `ReactNode`, optional.

It also takes the 263 attributes React's DOM types give it (`className`, `style`, `id`, `aria-*`, the event handlers among them).
